name: Summarize documents accessed via external links or files
description: Users asked the AI to summarize, index, or extract specific excerpts from documents, articles, or reports accessed via provided URLs, PDFs, or external links. The requests often involved formatting the output as bullet points, creating study indexes, or adhering to strict character limits for selected text.
